jonwheatley-pixel-path-root.description: Pixel Path turns any two places (optionally via waypoints) into a pixel-art fly-through of the real road. It routes the trip, bakes the real buildings, land cover, landmarks, hills and horizon from OpenStreetMap and elevation data, generates scenery art with RetroDiffusion at a chosen level of detail (sparse, moderate or detailed; estimated up front, quoted exactly for free, budget-capped; free placeholder art also works), builds a page where you zoom along the route and scroll to go faster or slower, and runs a self-check that screenshots the result. Use when someone asks for a "pixel path",…
